{{Top|leg}}
'''Permacite''' was a compound substance made of [[permex]] and a variety of light-reactive minerals. It was stronger than normal permex and was commonly used as a building material in structures that were expected to endure a high level of stress.

The shell of [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards']] [[V-150 Planet Defender/Legends|v-150 Planet Defender]] [[planetary ion cannon]] was constructed of permacite.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
